title: A summary a memory carries stops standing for the room once a turn it covers is edited: the next read summarizes its window afresh, the turn as edited
notes: As a-summary-ends-once-a-turn-it-covers-is-deleted, Python's SummarizingMemory over an 11-event window: at the fourth question Question 1 to Answer 2 are summarized (Summary 1). Alice then edits Question 1 (an inbound edit, from its sender). The turn no longer says what the summary read, so at the fifth question the summary no longer stands: the summarizer reads the window again, Question 1 as corrected, with no prior summary (Summary 2).
